title: React devtools panel
firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Open the browser devtools with F12 or Cmd+Option+I, then pick the Example tab
Edit src/panel/PanelApp.tsx and save to see the panel update
useCases: A React devtools panel as the primary UI surface
Inspecting the current page from inside the developer tools
Starting point for debugging tools built as browser extensions

store.summary: Adds a React devtools panel to the browser that reads the inspected page.
store.reviewerHints: Start by opening the developer tools on any page and picking the Example tab.
versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the devtools-react template. Not yet submitted to any store.
